title: cephalaria mediterranea
intro: Cephalaria mediterranea, commonly known as the Mediterranean cephalaria or goat's beard, is a flowering plant species in the honeysuckle family (Caprifoliaceae). It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which help to alleviate various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Cephalaria mediterranea include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
